title: FemTheme Solo #013 · 여 토운드 밤쉘·락혼글램·산타 테마
prompt:
Image format: a vertical portrait-orientation photograph, 2:3 aspect ratio, taller than it is wide.

A full-body photograph in the carved stone galleries of Angkor Wat with sunlit sandstone paving, standard-height doorways and low stone steps, empty of tourists, bright and evenly lit, shadows soft, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus, completely empty of other people, no readable signs or text anywhere, no props or statues made of the same material as her, NO dark background NO black void, ONE person standing, sharp focus from head to toe, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/8, in natural sunlight, sharp focus on every figure, realistic photographic grain — a real photograph, not an illustration, not CGI, not a render.

SUBJECT: ONE real adult Thai woman, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, flawless pale-golden skin, sharply defined dark brows, a precise black winged liner with a strong flick, warm brown-bronze eyeshadow, long dramatic lashes, large eyes with bright real catchlights, strong contour under the cheekbones, deep red glossy lips with a crisp edge, a poised, dramatic expression, bold vivid tangerine-orange hair styled in a layered wolf cut with curtain bangs, real living eyes, wearing a different earring on each ear: on one ear a single long rose-gold chain ending in one large faceted pearl-cluster drop, and on the other ear a large bronze hoop carrying four heavy rough hammered matte metal weights on bronze chains of different lengths (a silver small flared temple bell, a silver ship's anchor, a lead barrel-shaped weight, a lead pyramid-shaped lump), all hanging clear of the body and none below the collarbone, and a single mixed-metal bracelet. Extremely long round nails, chrome finish studded with crystals.
SUBJECT Physique: an extraordinarily curvaceous but athletic woman, far beyond any real person; a flat, firmly defined stomach with faint abdominal muscle lines, a very narrow waist, strong rounded shoulders and toned arms, powerful toned thighs and a high firm rounded rear, yet a colossal full bust and wide round hips that keep the dramatic hourglass shape; hard fit muscle under glowing skin, not bulky, not thin, not boyish; her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.
SUBJECT Outfit: Her skin is bare and unpainted, wearing a red velvet Santa hat with a white fur trim and pom-pom and white fur cuffs on both wrists, a red silk scarf folded into the narrowest possible strip only two fingers tall, stretched tightly across the middle of her bust and knotted in a small knot at the side of her bust right beside one breast, one end of the silk trailing long down her side and the other end cut short, fully opaque and covering only what it must, and a minimal red silk micro bikini bottom of one tiny low-rise opaque triangle on thin side strings tied at the hips, the small opaque piece fully covering her, her stomach fully visible.
SUBJECT Pose: square to camera, feet wide, arms clear of her body.
SUBJECT Footwear: Extreme gold needle heels with a razor-thin tapered heel a full forty inches tall and a twelve-inch hidden front platform.

Skin (everyone): Real photographic skin — visible pores and fine grain, a taut surface with natural creases and shadow only where the flesh and muscle fold. No smooth illustration finish, no plastic CG sheen.

Background & Lighting: each material catching the sunlight in sharp glints, the sunlight carving every fold, curve and muscle. Vertical 2:3 portrait-orientation full-body photograph, taller than it is wide, the face toward the camera.
